entry: Spring TestContext cache → JUL and Logback appender

questions.history: With cache pausing active, emit the third marker from the resumed first context.
questions.prediction: Issue #51958 reports lost JUL output after this sequence on Boot 4.1.1 with Framework 7.0.9. On the merge the appender should receive the third marker.
questions.basis: The first and third tests share their cached context. The landed ordered nested tests check captured JUL output in all three.
questions.refutation: The first marker reaches Logback but the third does not, despite a successfully resumed context.

questions.history: On both revisions repeat with the Framework cache pause policy set to `-Dspring.test.context.cache.pause=never` at JVM startup.
questions.prediction: The logging backend should receive all three markers. The issue author reports that this policy makes the sequence pass.
questions.basis: The sequence reuses both contexts without the lifecycle transition implicated in the issue.
questions.refutation: The third bridged record disappears even with pausing disabled.

questions.history: On the merge repeat the default-policy sequence, followed by a second switch to `context=two`. Emit distinct JUL and direct SLF4J markers after each reuse. Count each marker at a single dedicated Logback appender.
questions.prediction: Both paths should deliver each marker once after either resume. Ignore unrelated framework messages and preserve their source labels.
questions.basis: A direct backend record controls for capture itself. Counting JUL markers detects both lost bridge delivery and duplicate handlers.
questions.refutation: Direct logging succeeds but a JUL marker is absent or doubled after a switch.
